thread:
Sam Sales: Morning team — quick sync on ProofPoint POC. Customer wants a 6-week POC starting May 12. Need to align success criteria, SE/eng support windows, and final deliverables. Can we confirm resources?

Mike_SE: I'm available for week 1 and week 3 (architecture + hardening). Who's covering day-to-day integration after week 1? @Tess_Eng?

Tess_Eng: I can do onboarding + infra setup in week 1 (2 full days). After that I'm limited to on-call hours. We need a dedicated GPU instance for the load/eval runs — please open quota request now.

Elaine_AM: I'll handle customer comms and lock down their eval prompts. Proposed success metrics: 1) 95th pctl latency < 400ms for 512 tokens; 2) generation quality pass rate >= 85% on a 50-sample eval set; 3) embeddings A/B lift > 5% vs current baseline.

Mike_SE: For automated evaluation, propose this seed prompt and metrics: ```
Prompt: "Summarize the user issue into 3 concise action items."
Metrics: BLEU, ROUGE, and a binary human pass/fail.
```
Who will coordinate the human annotations?

Nina_QA: QA can run the annotation in weeks 4–5. We'll need the labeling guide + 50 canonical samples by May 15. Can we freeze prompts by then?

Tess_Eng: Freezing prompts by May 15 works. I'll provision a Dedicated slot for the eval run; decision point: reserved capacity PO for short term discount or use hosted burst. Need direction from finance/sales.

Sam Sales: Customer asked about short-term reserved pricing for the 6-week POC. Also flagged data residency and retention. @Security_Ops can you confirm KMS + audit log retention options?

Security_Ops: We can provide KMS integration and 90-day audit logs for the POC. Started the security questionnaire — linked it here: https://redwood.internal/sg-forms/pp-poc. No technical blocker, just need DPA executed.

Mike_SE: Resource plan: I'll own eval harness and produce the runbook. I can spare 0.5 FTE for support during the run. Tess handles infra provisioning, Nina handles annotations, Elaine manages customer ops. Deliverables: SE runbook, test matrix, and smoke scripts by May 8.

Sam Sales: Great — owners: Mike_SE (runbook + eval), Tess_Eng (infra/provision), Nina_QA (annotation), Elaine_AM (customer comms). Action items: 1) Runbook + schedule by May 8; 2) Prompts + sample dataset freeze by May 15; 3) Capacity + billing approach by May 10. Any objections?

Elaine_AM: No objections. I'll send a calendar invite for weekly syncs and attach a success-criteria table so the customer signs off.

Tess_Eng: Opening infra ticket now: infra-req-5421. Will paste the link once created.

Sam Sales: Thanks all — if we hit those milestones we can keep to the May 12 start. :thumbsup:
